name: Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma)
description: Chronic autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by vasculopathy, immune dysregulation, and progressive fibrosis of skin and internal organs (lungs, heart, GI tract, kidneys). Two major subsets: limited cutaneous (lcSSc, CREST syndrome) and diffuse cutaneous (dcSSc). Lung involvement (ILD, PAH) is the leading cause of mortality.
primary_tissue: Skin, lungs, blood vessels, GI tract, heart, kidneys
